text: 中国人民银行统计，2026年二季度末，人民币普惠小微贷款余额38.52万亿元，同比增长8.3%，增速比各项贷款高3.1个百分点，上半年增加1.95万亿元。单户授信小于500万元的农户经营性贷款余额10.21万亿元，上半年增加3998亿元。助学贷款余额3509亿元，同比增长31.1%。
text_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, RMB inclusive small and micro loans totaled 38.52 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year, 3.1 percentage points higher than total loan growth, with an increase of 1.95 trillion yuan in H1. Household operating loans for farmers with single-account credit under 5 million yuan were 10.21 trillion yuan, with an increase of 399.8 billion yuan in H1. Student loans were 350.9 billion yuan, up 31.1% year-on-year.
